observations: Photo 0 shows a light-colored 2-seater couch/sofa with rounded arms and backrest, upholstered in what looks like fabric or faux leather.
Photo 0: visible creasing/wrinkling on the seat surface; no obvious large tears seen from this angle.
Photo 1 shows the corner/arm and seat area; there are faint marks/soiling and light discoloration on the seat/arm area.
No visible brand label, model tag, or manufacturer markings are readable in either photo.

claims.claim: Very neat 2 seater couch for sale
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos show some wrinkling/possible light staining/marks on seat and arm areas, so 'very neat' is not fully supported.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or heavy wear not visible in these angles (tears, sagging cushions, broken frame).
risks.proof: Request a short video showing the couch from all sides plus a sit-test (press down on each cushion and show bounce).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible wear (not 'like new'); assume cushions may be less firm and frame condition unknown.

risks.risk: Stains/odor (especially if upholstery is fabric/faux leather) that are not obvious in photos.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of the seat and arm areas in bright light, and ask for a quick smell/cleaning history confirmation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having visible light marks/possible staining; assume needs cleaning.

risks.risk: Material type and durability (fabric vs faux leather) affecting resale value and maintenance.
risks.proof: Request a close-up of the upholstery texture and stitching, and whether it peels/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced conservatively as generic used upholstery (maintenance/peeling risk unknown).

risks.risk: Size/fit mismatch (exact dimensions, whether it’s truly standard 2-seater).
risks.proof: Request measurements: length, seat width, seat depth, and height (back).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a typical 2-seater with unknown exact dimensions.

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of the seat surface and both arm corners (bright light) showing any stains/tears clearly.
Send a short video walking around the couch and showing cushion firmness (press test) and any squeaks.
Provide exact measurements (length, seat width/depth, back height).
Confirm upholstery material (fabric vs faux leather) and whether it has any peeling/cracking.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a 2-seater couch from the photos, but the seller’s 'very neat' claim is not fully supported due to visible wrinkling/possible marks. Key value drivers (cushion firmness, frame condition, and upholstery condition/material) need proof before pricing confidently.
